reports.title: SOMNIGROUP INTERNATIONAL INC. REPORTS RECORD THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS

guidance.heading: Financial Guidance
section: For the full year 2026, the Company revised its expectations for adjusted EPS to a range of $2.85 to $2.95, which represents an approximate 7% increase from 2025 adjusted EPS at the mid-point of the range.
